summary: IB Acquisition Corp., a Nasdaq-listed SPAC, filed an 8-K/A describing a September 15, 2026 Equity Purchase Facility Agreement tied to its pending business combination with GNQ Insilico, Inc. The ELOC Investor commits up to $50 million in gross purchase price for newly issued Class A shares over a 36-month period following resale registration effectiveness. Pricing is VWAP-based, subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap (increasable to 9.99%) and a 19.99% exchange cap absent stockholder approval. IB will issue a $675,000 convertible Commitment Note. Shares will trade as GNQI. Watch dilution, registration timing, and deal closure.
